stream_encoding: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one JSON object per line
record_order: canonical_form_witness, group_element_discard, or numeric_infeasibility zero or more times

common_semantics.state: A strictly increasing list of k distinct residues in [0, modulus).
common_semantics.path: Nonempty engine decisions from the declared root to this cell; identity only.
common_semantics.subtree_id: A nonempty engine-chosen subtree identity; identity only.
common_semantics.fingerprint: Lowercase SHA-256 of the compact canonical JSON encoding of canonical_state.

profiles.canonical_augmentation: Log one canonical_form_witness for every classified node. The live DFS names no retained partner. The replayer builds fingerprint -> retained node after the complete stream is loaded, then pairs discarded witnesses offline.
profiles.direct_group_element: Alternative for engines that already compute a discard-to-retained mapping; emit group_element_discard.
profiles.numeric_infeasibility: For singleton-deficit pruning; emit numeric_infeasibility. This is not a symmetry claim.

required.canonical_state: sorted image of the node state under permutation

canonical_form_witness.offline_pairing: After all records validate, retained witnesses are indexed by fingerprint. Each discarded witness must have exactly one retained fingerprint bucket and an equal canonical_state. A discard-to-retained map is reconstructed as inverse(retained permutation) after discard permutation.

required.retained_target_node_id: node ID classified retained by canonical_form_witness
required.mapped_state: sorted group image, equal to retained target state

required.deficits: entry i is 0 when count is 0 or >=3, otherwise 3-count

numeric_infeasibility.acceptance: The replayer recounts the node and accepts the prune only when required_repairs > available_repairs. The producer must choose and document a sound max_repairs_per_addition bound for its engine; v2 mechanically checks the logged arithmetic and exact leaf case.

verdicts.legitimacy: Schema, identities, group membership, canonical images, fingerprints, direct mappings, and record counts.
verdicts.completeness: Every root-partition cell appears exactly once and is classified exactly once; every canonical discard pairs offline to a retained canonical form.
verdicts.infeasibility: Every numeric record has correct arity, exact recount/deficits, correct arithmetic, and a strict deficit bound.

non_guarantees: Opaque path and subtree identifiers do not prove traversal coverage; v2 coverage uses explicit states.
For remaining_additions > 0, soundness of max_repairs_per_addition is an engine-specific trust boundary unless separately certified.
No search predicate, encoder, serializer, SAT verdict, or encoding-faithfulness bridge is checked.
